**certfan 0.4.0** — mail servers and databases get the same every-node check: STARTTLS for SMTP, IMAP, POP3 and PostgreSQL, plus ALPN.

The MTAs behind `mx.example.com` and the primary and replicas behind `db.internal` renew just as often as your web
fleet, and miss the reload just as often. Until now certfan could not reach them, because they only start TLS after
a plaintext greeting.

- **`--starttls smtp|imap|pop3|postgres`**: speak just enough of the protocol to ask for TLS (SMTP `EHLO` /
  `STARTTLS`, IMAP `CAPABILITY` / `STARTTLS`, POP3 `CAPA` / `STLS`, PostgreSQL `SSLRequest`), then compare
  certificates node by node exactly as for HTTPS. The default port follows the protocol (25 / 143 / 110 / 5432).
- **Stage-aware failures:** a node that does not advertise STARTTLS, refuses it (`454`, `NO`, `-ERR`, `N`) or stalls
  in the preamble is a FAIL that says so, even with `--allow-unreachable`. Plaintext sent after the go-ahead (the
  STARTTLS response-injection bug class) is refused instead of being fed into TLS.
- **Guard rails:** `--starttls` on 465 / 993 / 995 is a usage error (those speak TLS directly), and plain TLS on a
  STARTTLS port that fails like plaintext now says `try --starttls PROTO`.
- **`--alpn h2,http/1.1`**: offer protocols and WARN when nodes select different ones (`alpn:h2` in text, `alpn` /
  `alpn_offered` in JSON, `certfan_node_alpn_info{...,alpn="h2"}` in Prometheus).
- Targets files take per-line `starttls=PROTO|none` and `alpn=P1,P2`; JSON nodes gain `starttls`, `banner` and
  `error_stage`; SMTP nodes show the name they greet with (`as mx3.example.com`).
- `certfan demo --starttls smtp` runs four local mail nodes: two current, one stale, one that never offers STARTTLS.

```bash
certfan check mx.example.com --starttls smtp
certfan check db.internal --starttls postgres --cafile corp-root.pem
certfan check shop.example.com --alpn h2,http/1.1
```

Install: `pipx install "git+https://github.com/Blackman99/certfan@v0.4.0"` or the wheel below.
Zero dependencies, Python 3.9+.
